description: Takes the Development site's private preview offline, the way the dashboard's Unpublish does: https://<slug>-dev.gemmein.dev stops answering. Every version and its files are kept — site_publish or site_rollback puts it up again. Development only: the Live site, https://<slug>.gemmein.dev, is never taken offline from here. On the site's history and the founder's Logs.
name: site_unpublish
title: Take the preview offline
